title: Triggered
blurb: Distorted, alarming, and inseparable from a red filter shaking violently at eleven frames per second. This sting defined an entire era of meme aesthetics — roughly 2016 onwards — when overreaction itself was the joke and every minor irritation was presented as a total psychological collapse. The format has aged into something almost nostalgic, a document of a particular internet moment with its own visual grammar. Play it the instant somebody's composure visibly departs the building. Vintage, slightly dated, and still completely effective on anybody who was online at the time.
origin: The sting from the classic 'triggered' reaction meme format.
